mentions.name: Calljmp
mentions.description: Calljmp is a backend platform for mobile apps, fully powered by Cloudflare. It offers unbeatable pricing, row-level security (RLS), app attestation, raw SQLite queries, and more, and is already live.
mentions.audience: Mobile app developers seeking a backend service
mentions.source_excerpt:
Now connecting all the dots and building a backend for mobile apps. It’s already live https://calljmp.com

Fully powered by Cloudflare, unbeatable pricing, rls and app attestation, raw SQLite queries, and tons more.

Looking for early feedback and adaptors.
